verdict.justification: The project is focused on developing a web-based system for managing parochial processes and activities, which falls under the Information Systems category. The secondary category of Web Applications is assigned due to the development of a web application for the Parroquia San Martín de Porres. The keywords 'Sistemas de Información Administrativa', 'Framework (Programa para computadores)', and 'Gestión de procesos; Control de actividades' further support this classification.
keywords_cited: Gestión de procesos; Control de actividades
